name: cyso-invoicing
description: Invoicing for small businesses: ask about and prepare invoices, quotations, receipts and expenses in your CySo Invoicing account.

interface.longDescription: CySo Invoicing is invoicing software for small businesses. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your CySo Invoicing account so you can ask about your invoices, quotations, receipts, expenses, clients and totals (for example what is unpaid or overdue), prepare draft invoices and quotations for existing clients, record payments and add expenses. You decide per API key what ChatGPT may do, and anything that creates or sends something needs your confirmation first. ChatGPT only gets your data after you create a connector key in the app, and only what that key allows.
